name: Le garage
style: ink and gouache storybook, natural daylight, curved teal truss and circular window

items.surface: left workbench; clay base touches oak top
items.camera: front three-quarter, eye level, downward view of horizontal surfaces
items.pose: A slab of CLAY holds a deep KEY impression, with the silver key at its foot. CLAY recalls clé [KLAY].

card.hook: A slab of CLAY holds a deep KEY impression, with the silver key at its foot. CLAY recalls clé [KLAY].

items.surface: left workbench; timber block rests on oak top
items.camera: front three-quarter, eye level, downward view of horizontal surfaces
items.pose: A goggled frog crouches on a PLANK, ready to PLUNGE. Plunge is an approximate cue for planche [PLAHNSH].

card.hook: A goggled frog crouches on a PLANK, ready to PLUNGE. Plunge is an approximate cue for planche [PLAHNSH].
card.note: The French final sound is sh, rather than the j sound in English plunge.
ex: Il coupe une planche de bois.

items.surface: floor behind left workbench; bench occludes lower ladder
items.camera: front three-quarter, eye level, downward view of horizontal surfaces
items.pose: A SHELL rests on top of a wooden LADDER: a shell recalls échelle [ay-SHEHL].

card.hook: A SHELL rests on top of a wooden LADDER: a shell recalls échelle [ay-SHEHL].

items.surface: left foreground slate floor; bicycle stand and robot feet grounded
items.camera: front three-quarter, eye level, downward view of horizontal surfaces
items.pose: A little blue robot tightens the wheel nut to REPAIR a bicycle. Réparation [ray-pah-rah-SYOHN] means repair; this is a meaning picture, not a full sound pun.

card.hook: A little blue robot tightens the wheel nut to REPAIR a bicycle. Réparation [ray-pah-rah-SYOHN] means repair; this is a meaning picture, not a full sound pun.
card.note: Une réparation is a repair; faire réparer means to have something repaired.
ex: La réparation du vélo est terminée.

items.surface: back wall niche stone sill; small architectural model
items.camera: front three-quarter, eye level, downward view of horizontal surfaces
items.pose: A red car is parked inside a miniature GARAGE. The French word sounds gah-RAHZH, with a soft zh ending.

card.hook: A red car is parked inside a miniature GARAGE. The French word sounds gah-RAHZH, with a soft zh ending.
ex: The car is in the garage.

items.surface: right cupboard door; both mounting plates screwed to wood
items.camera: front three-quarter, eye level, downward view of horizontal surfaces
items.pose: A tiny kangaroo grips a sliding door BOLT. Roo cues the ending of verrou [veh-ROO]; the first syllable is veh.

card.hook: A tiny kangaroo grips a sliding door BOLT. Roo cues the ending of verrou [veh-ROO]; the first syllable is veh.
card.note: A verrou is a sliding bolt, not a key-operated lock (une serrure).
ex: Il ferme la porte au verrou.

items.surface: slate floor in front of right workbench; figure and freestanding easel grounded
items.camera: front three-quarter, eye level, downward view of horizontal surfaces
items.pose: A craftswoman assembles a BRICK COLLAGE: a homemade DIY project, bricolage [bree-koh-LAHZH].

card.hook: A craftswoman assembles a BRICK COLLAGE: a homemade DIY project, bricolage [bree-koh-LAHZH].

items.surface: right foreground slate floor; adult carpenter at human scale
items.camera: front three-quarter, eye level, downward view of horizontal surfaces
items.pose: A carpenter proudly holds up the tall stool he made in his WORKSHOP, atelier [ah-tuh-LYAY]. This is a meaning picture.

card.hook: A carpenter proudly holds up the tall stool he made in his WORKSHOP, atelier [ah-tuh-LYAY]. This is a meaning picture.

items.surface: right slate floor; mole emerges through a broken tile
items.camera: front three-quarter, eye level, downward view of horizontal surfaces
items.pose: A mole emerges from a HOLE holding a golf ball. Trou is pronounced [TROO]; this is a meaning picture.

card.hook: A mole emerges from a HOLE holding a golf ball. Trou is pronounced [TROO]; this is a meaning picture.
ex: Il y a un trou dans le sol.
There is a hole in the floor.

dialogue.title: Réparer le vélo
lines: Tu peux m’aider à réparer mon vélo ?
Can you help me repair my bicycle?
Oui. Apporte-le dans le garage. Mon atelier est prêt.
Yes. Bring it into the garage. My workshop is ready.
Non, mais ferme le verrou et pose la clé sur la planche.
No, but slide the bolt shut and put the key on the plank.

map_entrance.building: small stone outbuilding beside the windmill
